Nutrient ratio reduced by GCD to N:P:K. Higher efficiency means less fertilizer for the same target, for formula fertilization and reduction estimation.
map.💡 公式：肥料用量 = 目标养分需求量 ÷ 肥料养分含量% ÷ 利用率%。例如尿: 💡 Formula: Fertilizer amount = target nutrient / fertilizer nutrient content % / efficiency %. E.g. urea amount = N demand / 0.46 / N efficiency.
